question: Can a scratch image model draw answers for unseen addition pairs when development and test pairs are separate?

dataset.split_rule: For each of 23 answers, eight unordered operand pairs train the model, two choose the checkpoint, and two remain sealed for the final test.
dataset.input: A 104 by 32 raster containing two seven-segment numbers, a plus sign, and an equals sign.
dataset.output: A 28 by 32 raster containing the answer modulo 23.

model.family: shared numeral reader, symmetric two-operand transformer, continuous raster writer

optimization.batch_construction: One randomly chosen rendering from every training pair at each update.

evaluation.test_rule: Load the checkpoint chosen from development results, then evaluate the test pairs once.
evaluation.swap_audit: Exchange the two operand rasters for every test pair and run one more forward pass.

selection.rule: Highest development exact-raster rate, then development answer accuracy, then training exact-raster rate, then lowest development pixel error.

execution.backend: MLX on the M4 Mac mini

reporting.success_threshold: At least 90 percent test accuracy for every seed.
